scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @openflow/contracts && npm run build --workspace @openflow/api && npm run build --workspace @openflow/worker && npm run build --workspace @openflow/dashboard
scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,worker,dashboard "npm run dev --workspace @openflow/api" "npm run dev --workspace @openflow/worker" "npm run dev --workspace @openflow/dashboard"
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @openflow/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build --workspace @openflow/contracts && dotenv -e .env -- npm run test:integration --workspace @openflow/api
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:integration && npm run build
